classifiedFinding.title: _safePay's return value is dead-code (always equals input); callers' re-assignment of the return value is misleading
classifiedFinding.justification: Low / QA. Pure code-hygiene issue. Post audit M-01 hardening, _safePay reverts on shortfall and returns input unconditionally; callers re-assign the return back over the input variable (no-op). Recommendation: drop the return value or restore partial-pay semantics (the latter would re-introduce the silent-forfeiture surface that M-01 closed).
